question.text: The lengths of sides of a cuboid are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math>. If the relative percentage error in the measurement of a is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>%</mo></math>, then what is the relative percentage error in the measurement of the volume of the cube.
